|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[4-LOM With Concussion Rifle (V) (Virtual Block 6)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-01-4_LOM_With_Concussion_Rifle-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 6.2 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[4-LOM With Concussion Rifle (V) (Virtual Block 6)]].
* '''Original''' ([[4-LOM With Concussion Rifle (V) (Virtual Block 6)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Permanent weapon is •4-LOM's Concussion Rifle (may target a character for free; target is power -1). Once per turn, may place a card from hand on bottom of Used Pile to draw top card from Reserve Deck.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 6.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 7, 2009"), page 2, slip 201. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the same text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=3, page 3. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 27 March 2014, effective immediately: “target is power -1” became “target is power -1 until end of turn”: “Permanent weapon is •4-LOM's Concussion Rifle (may target a character for free; target is power -1 until end of turn). Once per turn, may place a card from hand on bottom of Used Pile to draw top card from Reserve Deck.”<ref name="forum-p874174">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 27 March 2014: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p874174 p874174] (read 9 November 2026)</ref> The post (“The following rulings and errata are effective immediately”, Appendix A) gives the full text and the reason: “Until end of turn” was added “in order to prevent a duration issue”. The PC Holotable card data carries this text from 2018 (dating evidence only).
